correctness.rationale: For n>=2 the n uniform gaps have Dirichlet(1^n) law. For any set of j coordinates all exceeding t, its probability is (1-jt)^(n-1), and conditional remaining mass 1-jt is another uniformly distributed Dirichlet simplex. Expanding Q conditional on this event yields jt^2+2jt(1-jt)/n+2(1-jt)^2/(n+1). Inclusion-exclusion in E[M Q]=integral E[Q 1_{M>t}]dt reduces to the exact beta-integral contributions 2/(n(n+2)j)+2/(n(n+1)(n+2)j^2). Binomial sums for j^-1 and j^-2 give H_n and (H_n²+H_n^(2))/2, proving E[M Q] and covariance (H_n²+H_n^(2)-2H_n)/(n(n+1)(n+2)). Marginal Dirichlet fourth moments and maximum-gap tail formula give the displayed varQ and varM, with strict positivity because (H-1)^2+(H2-1)>0 for n>=2. Harmonic asymptotics prove covariance ~(log n)^2/n^3 and correlation ~(sqrt6/(2pi))(log n)^2/sqrt n. Independently calculated alternating binomial-beta formula and exact fractions for n=2..10 (n=2 covariance 1/48). Rotationally symmetric circular spacings have the same Dirichlet vector. This is not an independence theorem.
